mentions.name: Robomiri Analytics
mentions.description: A lightweight, privacy-first web analytics tool that captures page views, content engagement, funnels, and user paths in a minimal UI. It emphasizes actionable metrics over dashboards, with defaults like anonymization, flexible retention, and user control over what's collected, and aims to be GDPR/CCPA friendly.
mentions.problem: Analytics tools often turn users into tracked profiles and can feel creepy, and many provide dashboards to stare at rather than metrics you can act on.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building https://analytics.robomiri.com, a lightweight, privacy-first analytics tool that gives you real insight without turning your users into tracked profiles. It captures page views, content engagement, funnels, and user paths in a minimal UI.
